balls.text: Yorker outside off, dug out to long-off. Avesh closes it off well and now LSG need 191 to get off the mark in the points table
Goes for a wide yorker, it's quite wide, but Harshal is across the stumps and he manages to get a toe end as he lofts it down the ground towards long-off. They get two comfortably
ON a length outside off, Simarjeet hacks it down to long-on
Squeezes a low full toss back past Avesh to long-off
Full outside off, driven hard to the bowler's left. Avesh can't hold on and almost deflects it towards the stumps at the non-striker's end but well wide of it in the end
Full outside off, Harshal drives it down to long-off
Banged in short outside off, Simarjeet looks to ramp but can't connect. Shardul finishes with figures of 4-34. And he had just five wickets in the whole of IPL 2024 from nine games!
Throws his bat at a low full toss outside off, with an open face, and manages to deflect it to short third. They scamper across for a single
Full on off, Simarjeet drives it down to long-on
Shardul has a fourth! Short and wide, Shami looks to slap it away but can only get it off the toe end to cover as his right hand comes off the handle
Bouncer outside off, Shami swings and misses
Driven out to sweeper cover, as Harshal fails to take toll of this full toss outside off. They get two, though
Wide yorker, Harshal manages to squeeze it out to cover's left for a single
Short and wide, Harshal slaps it down the ground to long-off's left. They get two with ease
Low full toss outside off, Shami can only drive it out to deep point
Avesh with the comeback! Goes wide of the crease and goes full outside off. Cummins opens his face and looks to steer this past short third but it goes straight to the fielder
Three balls faced, three sixes hit for Pat Cummins! This is in the slot outside off and Cummins goes straight down the ground!
Yorker just outside off, Harshal digs it out towards midwicket and gets Cummins on strike

And now Cummins goes down the ground! This is a full toss outside off, a juicy one at that, and Cummins says thank you very much as he slaps this just to the right of the sightscreen. We've seen back-to-back sixes for the third consecutive over now
Cummins hits his first ball for six! Short and wide, Cummins is on his toes as he cuts this up and over point. Into the stands
ON a length outside off, punched out to deep point
Full outside off, driven to cover's right. Cummins wanted the single, but is sent back

Sliced in the air and Thakur has his third! Goes for the wide yorker again, Manohar goes deep in his crease and looks to go over point but this goes too fine and Samad gets under it, running in from deep third. Thakur has the purple cap now!
Brilliant from Shardul, nails the wide yorker as Manohar looks to go inside out but can't connect

And this time he holes out Sees this dropped slightly short and rocks back for the pull. But it wasn't a long hop and he can't get the distance on it. Miller makes no mistake. Aniket departs after injecting much-needed momentum into the innings
And now over extra cover! Full and wide, he gets on one knee and hammers it inside out. Back-to-back sixes in back-to-back overs
Doesn't miss this one! Gets across the stumps to take on this full ball and whips it over the square leg boundary
Aniket goes for a slog sweep and misses completely and is hit on the back thigh. But that was sliding down, though
Punches a length ball down to long-off
Tossed on a length outside off, Manohar blocks
Full on leg, he clips it into the forward square leg region. Good running as they get two as the run rate gets closer to 10 now
And that's even bigger! This time he targets the other side of the sight screen as he gets low to this tossed up delivery and boshes this down the ground
Aniket clears the rope again! Clears his front leg and deposits this slot ball over long-off
On a length on leg, tucked behind square leg and Manohar gets off the mark
Another googly outside off, Manohar lunges forward and defends

Knocks him over! Tossed up full on off, Reddy felt the pressure growing and looked for the big swing down the ground, but he can't pick the googly and hears the death rattle as his middle stump is pegged back

Back of length outside off at 135kph, Reddy pulls it wide of long-on. Prince Yadav bowls out with figures of 1 for 29. That was the wicket of Head he got, and he inadvertently also ran Klaasen out! Some day for him!
Driven down to long-on. This was full just outside off
Gets the wide yorker past Aniket's attempted drive! Took the pace off too. Aniket gets an bottom edge as it sneaks behind to Pant
Banged in too short. Wide called immediately as Aniket watches it sail over his shoulder

Goes for a yorker at 138kph, it's a low full toss but still right in the blockhole/ Aniket does very well to jam his bat down and squeeze it out towards mid-on. It's a bit of a vacant region and the batters do well to run two
On a length outside off, Aniket gets across the stumps but can only punch it to mid-off
Full outside off, driven wide of long-off

Goes downtown! This is in the slot, and Aniket thinks one ball is all the sighters he needs as he pummels this straight down. Aiden Markram at long-on gets in position but that's gone well above him! Much needed boundary for SRH
Tossed up on off, he eases it in front of square leg
On a length around off, going on with the angle, he tucks it wide of short fine leg for a quick single. The throw at the non-striker's end is a poor one and allows them to sprint back for a second
Tossed up full outside off, Reddy hits a crisp drive but straight to the extra cover fielder
Tucks a length ball square on the leg side and it allows them to run two, despite the direct hit at the striker's end
Legbreak outside off, he clips it through mid-on for a single

Klaasen is run out in bizarre fashion! This is overpitched and Reddy drives this hard to Prince's left. He goes low to take the catch, but can't hold on. But the ball deflects from his hands onto the stumps at the non-striker's end! Klaasen was out of his crease and starts to walk immediately. Prince has delivered the wickets of both Head and Klaasen today! He seems to have hurt his hand though
Short and wide, Reddy goes for the pull but gets an under-edge as the ball bounces to the keeper. Change of pace does the trick for Prince
Full outside off, Klaasen clubs it down the ground. Goes to long-on on the bounce

Creamed over cover! Gets it straight enough of the fielder in the deep! Overpitched and too wide, Klaasen gets under it and slices it in front of point. Deep point was running to his right but he placed this well enough. A check shows it bounced just short of the boundary rope
On a length just outside off, 138kph, hacked away to deep midwicket
Yorker down leg, tucked away to deep midwicket

On a length outside off, Reddy punches to cover. There's a bit of a mix-up as Klaasen takes off for the single but is sent back. Bishnoi doesn't collect the throw cleanly, or Klaasen could have been in trouble
Cramps him for room with a length ball finishing around leg, Klaasen works it through midwicket
Klaasen continues his takedown of legspin! This is on a length on the stumps, Klaasen hangs back, clears his left leg and punches it straight down the ground along the carpet. 100 up for SRH
Tossed up very full outside off, Reddy looks to slog sweep but can only get it off the bottom half to deep midwicket

Big appeal from Bishnoi, but the umpire is not interested at all. This is full around off, a wrong'un. NKR went for a reverse-sweep and missed. LSG review. And that's clipping leg, so umpire's call. Reddy survives
Bishnoi starts with a length ball outside off, Klaasen cuts it out to deep point
full on middle and leg now, and flicked away square for one
full on off at 138kmh, bunts it down to long-off for one
another slower one, moving away as well from outside off and left alone for another wide
bangs in a bouncer to Reddy which he can't put away and that's called a wide for going over the head
drills the full ball on stumps back and Prince uses his right leg to deflect that to leg side. Single taken
low and wide full toss well outside off, Klaasen swings and misses. Quite slow as well at 112kmh
short of length outside off, enough room for Reddy to hop on his toes and dab it to short third for a quick single. Could have been close has it been a direct hit
nails the yorker first ball and Klaasen bunts it away to midwicket for one
turning away from outside off, swatted like a mosquito racket to leg for one wide of long-on
Rathi replies with a decent legbreak outside off now, pushed to cover
and Klaasen takes off! Pitched up and Klaasen pounces on that, lofts it from bottom to top swing of the bat in his trademark fashion to send it crashing into the midwicket stands
turning in this time from outside off, cut to point
on middle now and tucked to leg for one more
on length on the stumps, pushes it down to long-on
in the block hole finally, just outside off and Reddy digs it out to cover with a straight bat
trying for the block hole maybe, delivers another full toss. This is on off and punched down to long-on for one
right on target again on the stumps with a length delivery, Klaasen punches it down past the stumps in the gap for two
strays down the leg side with a wide and sends down a wide

where's the crown in Hyderabad? Put it on Prince's head. And he has dismissed Travis Head in the most spectacular fashion, knocking over almost all his stumps. Pitches it up fearlessly, Head swings and misses and the ball crashes into the base of the stumps
a whippy flick from off stump to the leg side for a single
strays towards the leg side and Reddy tucks that off his hips, a little far from deep fine leg and far enough to send that for four
Head knocks over middle stump at the non-striker's end with a powerful stroke and it ends as a dot ball
pulls it down the ground but miscues towards long-off for one
punches that down the ground from outside off for one
really good comeback to bowl that tight around off, Head backs away to smash it but misses
and Head punishes them again! Some width is all he needs outside off and he cuts that away wide of point for another four

and LSG are all over the place now. First a misfield at short fine leg leaks one, a wayward throw at the bowler's end with nobody a the stumps concedes a second, and the fielder backing up messes up too. Three runs gifted in one ball
slightly straighter and he punches it to cover

dropped again, but a really tough chance! If that had stuck to Bishnoi's hand, what a relief it would have been for LSG. Head bludgeons the short ball back, Bishnoi extends his right arm to his right and touches the ball too but it doesn't stick
short again but much straighter and Head smashes it back, Bishnoi gets a hand to it and he's hurt himself
slammed over the covers, he's going to make you pay! Short and turning away, Head is not going to let that go away, gives it his everything and clears the long covers boundary
nudges this one into the covers for a quick single, nearly a mix up as well

Head has been dropped! I repeat, Head has been given a life. Skies Bishnoi's first ball down the ground, Pooran is stationed at long-on and he has all the time in the world to settle under, sticks his arms to his chest and gets both hands easily but puts it down. The crowd erupts!
backs away a long, long way and Rathi's line chases him, he whips it to leg and they run well to make it two
just short of mid-on! He's chasing the South Africans, Travis Head. Lofts this full delivery to Miller at mid-on, he dives forward as well, but it doesn't carry. Head and Miller both end up smiling
crashed in the air over the covers and it's going for a boundary but Markram sprints and dives to his right from long-off. Saves two
makes room but Rathi chases him with the line on leg, no room, and he punches to cover point
short ball coming in around off, Reddy swings it down the ground but it lands short of long-on
shortish again outside off, swatted away to leg for one in the deep
just short of length around off, whipped off the back foot to leg for one

flayed over the covers and four to end the over! Make that 18 from the over. Width again, angling away as well, nobody in the deep and Head sends that crashing over the covers after backing away slightly
much better length outside off, just a hint of room, and Head chases and misses

carved over the covers for six more! Make that two from the over. Full and wide, angling away too with no swing for him like Shardul, and Head goes after that to swing his bat away from the body nicely all the way
punches back with hard hands after the ball comes into him, he sends that back past the bowler but mid-off chases it down quickly
another yorker to Head, just outside off and he gets some bat on that towards cover point for one
there comes the first six of the night and it's from Travis Head. On length on the pads and he flicks that away by moving his front pad out of the way just a little, over wide long-on for 80 meters
classy drive! Gets one full delivery with some width and Reddy unleashes a wonderful cover drive to the left of mid-off for a cracking boundary
slow offcutter again well outside off, he hangs back before cutting it away square for one
follows that with a bouncer that Head tries to ramp but misses. Thakur thinks that's an edge too but the umpire calls it a wide. thakur looks at Pant for a review but the captain doesn't even react
slower one now at 113.1kmh, but well outside off and cutting away further. Left alone for a wide
tries another yorker but that's a low full toss swinging into middle stump and Head swings that down, along the carpet, and past Thakur for another boundary. SRH breathe again
excellent hat-trick ball - right in the block hole on middle stump and Reddy does well to get some bat under that and dig it out to mid-on

gone first ball! That's the magic of Shardul Thakur. Looks like the most innocuous delivery swinging down leg after pitching in front of the pads, Kishan feathers it behind and Pant doesn't even celebrate but Shardul does, and the umpire says it's out. Kishan looks disappointed, he's not reviewing that

Shardul gets the big wicket of Abhishek and raises his finger himself! They had placed one at deep square leg from Shardul's first over and he sends down a short ball which Abhishek pulls and that's gone straight to Pooran
too short to end the over and Head swats it after opening his stance, wide of mid-on and spoils what was looking like a good over from Avesh
excellent ball - in the block hole outside off and Head tries to dig it out. Only gets an edge to get the ball rolling behind
falls short of deep third! Abhishek throws his arms at that one and gets an edge flying to deep third where the fielder runs in but it doesn't carry
dead straight on middle stump, no room and he pushes it down to mid-off
more bounce this time outside off from short of length and he runs it down to short third
short of length and outside off, just a bit of width and Abhishek shows some excellent timing with that late dab to steer that wide of short third for four! Races away
short and wide to Abhishek, he bashes it into the ground with hard hands towards cover and he's off the mark too
another full toss! This one a tad higher outside off and swinging in which means Head can only steer it to deep point. There's protection there because short third is in the circle
full toss and luckily for LSG that's carved straight to point
smashed over the bowler's head for four and they're off! Full again, absolutely middled and Thakur reacted by raisin his right arm but where was the time!
full and swinging into leg stump, nicely cramped up and Head bunts it down to mid-on this time
smacks the first ball all guns blazing in the covers and Badoni dives to his right to save a boundary

And one ball is all Miller needs to drive this tossed up delivery over cover to complete a thumping win! Who would have though that it would be LSG chasing down SRH's total in 16.1 overs after all the hype around SRH's batting in the build-up?! LSG get their first win of the season
Tossed up full and he hits it back hard at the bowler. Miller is quick to dive back into his crease, well aware of how Klaasen got out earlier in the evening
On a length on the pads, Miller tucks it to backward square
Zampa goes short now and Samad rocks back and pulls it out to deep midwicket on the bounce. Just three needed for the win now
Drilled along the carpet to beat long-off now. Zampa goes full again, Samad punishes him again!
Samad is in a hurry here. Gets one in the slot and creams it just straight of long-off. The fielder tried to get across but to no avail
Floated up outside off, Miller drives it past the cover fielder to the off-side sweeper

Almost a blinder at long-off! This is overpitched outside off and Samad reaches out and lofts this down the ground. The fielder leaps with one arm stretched out in the air but Samad manages to clear him! Samad delivering blows against his old team
Drives this full ball to mid-off
On a length outside off, Samad stands tall and punches it past a diving cover fielder! Authoritative shot
Full just outside off, Miller gently pushes it towards the vacant mid-on region for an easy run
Full and wide, Samad reaches out and swats it out to deep point

What's happened here? That's a full toss that has Pant losing shape as he tries to smack it away. It goes off the edge to Shami at short third. Shami immediately signals it's going to be called no-ball for height. The umpires are having a check. Pant was out of his crease. And the ball tracking shows that had Pant been standing upright at the crease so he is out of here! Shakes his head as he walks back, as Harshal continues to damage LSG
Full toss angled across him, Pant misses the flick and it slides down leg
Yorker on middle, Pant manages to jam his bat down, meeting it with the full face to push it down the ground. That was bowled at almost 140kph as well!
Low full toss outside off, pushed towards mid-off for a quick run
Miller gets going Short and wide and he thrashes it past cover to pick up a boundary
Dug in short outside off, Pant looks to flat-bat it down the ground. It comes off the toe end as it goes to long-on on the bounce
Miller is cramped by a length ball angling into him, but manages to play a late cut to deep third
Back of length outside off, Pant backs away and slaps it down the ground to long-on

Skied in the air, and that's an excellent catch from Harshal Patel! He had to run in a long way from deep midwicket and then grab it low. Badoni had a swipe across the line to this full ball and got a top edge. SRH trying to make a contest out of this
Floated full on leg, Pant flicks it through square leg and gets a single
On a length on leg, tucked off his pads to deep square leg
Zampa keeps trying to keep it out of Pant's hitting arc. Pant at the moment is happy to just cut it away in the gap on the off side for a single
Loopy delivery, full around leg. Badoni backs away and drives this along the carpet to long-on
Length ball tossed across Pant, who slaps it out to the off side sweeper
On a length around off, he blocks it in front
Dug in short and Badoni plays a lovely pick-up flick! One bounce and four behind square leg!
Eased out to sweeper cover. That was quite wide and Pant had to reach out
Length ball angled across him, Pant throws his bat at it and gets an under-edge through to the keeper
On a length on middle and going across Pant, who backs away and looks to slap it down the ground, but can't get it past Simarjeet
And that is vintage Pant! This is in the slot around middle, Pant crouches really low and whips this behind square leg into the second tier!
Full outside off, driven to extra cover

Cummins has a second. This is almost yorker length around off and Marsh manages to just chip it harmlessly down the ground. Nitish Kumar Reddy runs in from long-on to take the catch. A good knock from Marsh comes to an end
On a length outside off, Marsh is beaten on the outside edge as he looks to drive

Over the leaping midwicket fielder! And that brings up a half-century for Marsh! Dug in short outside off, Marsh waits on it and pulls it. Shami can't get his hands on it and Marsh gets back-to-back fifties
And Marsh gets this one away. This is on a length outside off and he swings across the line. Doesn't hit it as cleanly as he'd have liked but places it too square for deep midwicket to stop
Banged in short outside off, Marsh pulls out of his attempted pull as it's called wide
Full outside off, driven hard to mid-off
full on off and driven along the carpet to long-off for one more
nice and loopy legbreak now on the stumps, Pant punches it back and Zampa gets a hand but deflects behind him for one
flat legbreak around off, pushed with the turn to deep cover for one more
Pant has his first run in IPL 2025 with a back-foot clip to leg side with the turn. Phew
outside off now and Marsh muscles that through extra cover for one
oh, terrible long hop down leg and Marsh sends that fine on the leg side instead of using power, to get four

and another one and Pant is on the ground now! A bouncer to follow the bouncer, Pant loses shape completely like he often does, tries to get bat on ball with a swipe but ends cup falling on the off side
oh hello, Rishabh Pant! 140kmh bouncer from Cummins which Pant juuust manages to duck under while taking his eyes off the ball. Nasty

struck in front of middle and the finger has gone up! Pooran has a chat with Marsh and goes for the review. Only an edge can save him though. Angling in from outside off, pitching just outside off, hitting in line and hitting middle and leg. No edge and review and Pooran both gone
slow and wide again, Marsh slams that down to long-on for one
scythed to deep third for four. That went like a rocket. Full of and wide, Marsh opened the face late close to the ground and carved that over a square short third
slow and wide, they're all trying to keep the ball away from the batters but bowling wides. Well outside off

fine leg is in, Pooran scoops Cummins away with a hop to the off side and that's racing away for four but Simarjeet is not giving up the chase. He slides last minute to keep it in, oh the ball is roling towards the ad cushion. Simarjeet jumps back in quickly and drags the ball in just in time. But saves only one after all that effort, which may not make a difference in this chase
135.3kmh, a full toss to end the over, it's wide outside off and he steers it late to deep third. Keeps strike as well
finally gets it straight and Pooran has been waiting! Pulls that with utter disdain, in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket for a cracking four
and another! SRH feeling the nerves and the heat. Low and wide full toss and another extra
and another wide! Bangs this one in short outside off, Pooran leaves it alone
inside edges the booming drive to the leg side for one and that's the century partnership off just 41 balls
too short, slow and wide outside off. Called a wide
131.7kmh, short and wide outside off, Marsh eyes the leg side though and he middles that pull along the ground to bisect the gap between two fielders in the deep there
full and wide, and Pooran goes low quickly to steer it to deep third
starts with a length ball outside off and Marsh drives that down to long-on
wide outside off now at 92.4kmh, crashed off the back foot and straight to point this time

drops that short and quick on leg, and Pooran is quick enough to swat paddle it fine without moving much, and a bit of misfield from a diving short fine leg gets four more. That should have been stopped though
that's a wide as well but Pooran loves the length, reaches out for it and sends that downtown for his sixth six already in 20 balls!
goes wide outside off this time and quick at 94.1kmh, left alone for a wide
there it goes into the second tier! Zampa strays on the leg side, Pooran pounces on that and slog sweeps yet again, high into the stands for his 18-ball fifty
low and dipping full toss on middle and leg, slammed back for a single off Zampa's left hand
wide and going away with the arm, he chases and mistimes a little towards cover for one
pace off again outside off, he taps to cover point and they make it across for a quick single
short and wide again, he waits and checks his slap to cover point. Reaches him after a bounce
short, slow and wide outside off, Pooran misses this but it's called wide

scooped away this time for four, where will you bowl to him? He's expecting another one wide outside off and shuffles that side quickly while opening the face of the bat to leg and directs the ball over short fine leg
inside edge and nearly chops on! He takes the pace off to bowl at 118.6kmh, and wide outside off, Pooran reaches out for a heave and mistimes it but the ball thuds into his pads
smashed back for four. Pooran is unstoppable! Poor delivery as well, quite full on off and Pooran won't let that go. Sends that crashing over Marsh's head and that races to the boundary
starts with a near yorker on middle and leg and Marsh bunts it down to mid-on for a quick single

make that two in two and it's raining sixes in Hyderabad! Gets down quickly again, sweeps it again, middles it again, and this time square of the wicket. Fielder in the deep or not, this one's for the crowd

there comes the Pooran slog sweep for six! That was the danger of bowling a left-arm spinner to Pooran and he shows why first ball. Gets down on a knee to the ball on off and smacks it over deep midwicket
poor ball down leg but he gets away as Marsh mistimes the pull and gets a single off the back of the bat after it deflected off his pad
full on middle and leg and gently pushed into the covers
too full and whipped away for four on the leg side. It was pitched up, Marsh opened up and he flicked that away along the ground with some power to beat the sliding fielder in the deep
outside off, he punches off the back foot straight to cover
thuds into his pads outside leg and they hare across for a leg bye
fetch that! Pitched up again and Marsh, almost on the move towards off middles that straight drive yet again, straight over mid-on for another spectacular six. He is middling it like never before
a leave! Would you believe it. A length ball outside off and he lets it go. Even sports a smile after that
straight like an arrow! Pitched up, no swing really and Marsh lofts that beautifully down the ground, wonderful follow through and classy straight loft
angling in from around the wicket, just wide of off and he steers it square for one
through a diving cover fielder! Pooran drove on the up, the ball stayed in the air for a bit as the fielder dived to his left but couldn't catch hold of it
really good ball for a reply, short of length on off and makes Pooran hop on the back foot. He dabs it square for a single
make that two in two like SRH did at the end of their innings! This one is even bigger as Simarjeet goes short again and Pooran stays back for a meaty pull square of the wicket, 97 meters far. Phew!
smoked over long-on and that lands in the crowd! He gets the length that's slightly short, rocks back for it to transfer weight on the back foot and heaves over long on
nice and tight on off stump, no room and he defends it square
a bouncer now over the batter and he ducks under it
back foot punch square of he wicket to deep point where Reddy reaches the ball with a slide to his left, gets both hands too but it gos through him for four!
excellent ball to end the over, some outswing on off stump and Marsh defends
flicked into the sky off his pads, the fielders chase from inside the ring but that's gone over for four after a bounce. Marsh is off like he was against Starc
still swinging in, this time into the pads for one behind square
oh my! Swings that a mile down the leg side way past the pads and the diving Klaasen for five wides

straight to mid-off! Markram drives the length ball on the up and hands a straightforward catch to Cummins. Perishes only for 1 against his former side. Shami strikes with the new ball again and crowd loves it!
swing now, into Marsh from length and he adjusts last minute to tuck it to leg for one
starts with a length ball on off, respectfully blocked by Marsh
outside off and it's driven straight to the fielder again
flat arm ball towards leg stump, Markam punches it back
much straighter on middle and leg now, driven down for another quick single
shortish and turning away, cuts it straight to point

some turn from off stump and it's driven into the covers for one. A run out chance at the non-striker's end and Markram gets a life! He was gone had Cummins hit the stumps, or if Abhishek had collected and whipped the bails off
starts on middle and leg and Marsh clips him to leg for one
